question.text: An acquirer plans to make an open offer where the total consideration payable is Rs. 350 crore. Applying the SEBI (SAST) escrow scale, what is the minimum escrow amount required?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook escrow scale is 25% of the consideration on the first Rs. 500 crore, plus 10% of the balance. For an open offer of Rs. 350 crore the whole consideration falls within the first Rs. 500 crore slab, so the escrow is 25% x Rs. 350 crore = Rs. 87.5 crore. The Trap: Rs. 100 crore is a popular distractor that assumes a fictitious "Rs. 100 crore floor". The SAST formula does not contain such a floor — for offers up to Rs. 500 crore the escrow is simply 25% of the consideration. Note: The 10% rate only kicks in on the slice of consideration that exceeds Rs. 500 crore, so it has no effect on a Rs. 350 crore offer.
